title: [Cysaegir, Cave]
description: Stalagmites create natural pillars in this cyclopean chamber that leads toward a steel-banded ironwood door.  A milky iridescent substance coats the walls and floors, giving off a bluish color that seems to glow as it illuminates this section of the cave.
